title: Shopify Development in South Carolina
metaTitle: Shopify Development in South Carolina | TDM
metaDescription: Shopify stores for South Carolina brands and retailers: custom themes, migrations, apps and speed. A member of our team is based in South Carolina.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) builds and relaunches Shopify stores for South Carolina brands, makers and retailers. We design custom themes, set up products and collections, integrate the apps you need and remove the ones slowing the store down. Many businesses here have a ready audience they are not yet selling to: the visitors who bought something in Charleston, Greenville or Myrtle Beach and would order again from home if the online store made it easy.

sections.heading: Why online stores matter for South Carolina sellers
paragraphs: Tourism brings a steady stream of customers through shop doors on King Street, at the Charleston City Market, along the Grand Strand and on Hilton Head. Most of them leave the state within a week. A Shopify store, connected to the till through Shopify POS, turns a one-off holiday purchase into a customer you can email and sell to all year.

The state also produces things people want shipped. Lowcountry food is the obvious example: stone-ground grits, rice, barbecue sauces, tea, pecans and peaches in season. These and the state's clothing, golf and fishing brands compete nationally, so the store has to load fast, look right on a phone and make checkout simple.

sections.heading: Things a South Carolina store has to get right
paragraphs: Shipping is the first. Food sent in a hot, humid summer needs rules for which products can ship when, which services are offered and what packaging costs are added. We configure shipping profiles and product availability so customers see accurate options and you do not lose margin on every box.

Tax is the second. South Carolina has a state sales tax with local taxes on top that differ by county, and selling into other states brings its own obligations. Shopify can calculate this, but it has to be set up correctly, and we recommend confirming the settings with your accountant.

Timing is the third. Gift-driven stores do much of their yearly trade before the winter holidays, while stores tied to tourism see online orders follow the visitor seasons. A relaunch or migration should be finished and tested before your peak, not during it.

sections.heading: What we do on a Shopify build
paragraphs: Shopify takes care of hosting, checkout and payment security. The difference between stores comes from what is built on top, and that is where we work.
bullets: Custom theme design and build on Shopify's Online Store 2.0 architecture.
Product pages, collections, cart and checkout flows designed to convert.
App integration for reviews, subscriptions, bundles, loyalty and shipping, with the app list audited for speed.
Shopify POS and inventory setup for businesses with a physical shop.
Migration from WooCommerce, Magento or other platforms, with products, customers, orders and redirects carried over.
SEO structure, structured data, image optimisation and Core Web Vitals tuning.
Multi-currency storefronts and international shipping settings for brands selling abroad.

sections.heading: Before you hire a Shopify developer
paragraphs: Make sure the store is opened in your name, with the developer added as a collaborator. Ask how many apps the build will rely on and what they cost each month, since app fees add up quietly. Ask how redirects will be handled if you are moving from another platform.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to build a Shopify store in South Carolina?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of your catalogue, the level of custom design and the integrations needed. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long does a Shopify store take to launch?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements, the number of products and how ready your photos and descriptions are. We agree the timeline in the plan and aim to finish before your busy season.

faqs.q: Can you connect my shop in Charleston or Myrtle Beach to an online store?
faqs.a: Yes. With Shopify POS, in-store and online sales share one product list and one stock count, and customers from the shop can be invited to buy online later.

faqs.q: Can you move my store from WooCommerce or Magento to Shopify?
faqs.a: Yes. We migrate products, customers and order history, rebuild the design on Shopify and map redirects from old addresses to new ones so existing rankings and links keep working.

faqs.q: Is Shopify the right platform for my business?
faqs.a: For most consumer brands and retailers, yes. If you have complex B2B pricing or a very large catalogue tied to an ERP, Magento or a custom build may suit better. We build on all of them and will tell you which fits.
